summary:
亞馬遜公司（AMZN）最新季度財報每股收益（EPS）符合預期，達1.95美元，收入達213.39億美元
• 季度收入達213.39億美元
• EPS符合預期，達1.95美元
• 公司的雲端計算事業繼續穩定增長
ai_view:
亞馬遜公司的財報表明公司的基本面仍然穩固，尤其是在雲端計算事業方面，對股價的短中期影響看好，關鍵追蹤指標包括公司的收入增長率和雲端計算事業的發展

需留意：全球經濟不確定性可能影響消費者支出；競爭加劇可能對公司的市場份額造成壓力

summary_en:
Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) reported quarterly earnings with EPS in line with estimates at $1.95 and revenue of $213.39B
• Quarterly revenue reached $213.39B
• EPS was in line with estimates at $1.95
• The company's cloud computing business continued to grow steadily

The earnings report suggests Amazon's fundamentals remain solid, particularly in cloud computing, with a positive near-term implication for the stock price; key metrics to track include revenue growth rate and the development of the cloud computing business

Watch：Global economic uncertainty may impact consumer spending; Increasing competition may pressure the company's market share
beat_or_miss: 符合預期，EPS與預期值相符，且有0.22%的驚喜
